ground_truth.title: GAME CHANGER
ground_truth.main_content:
The most advanced gaming GPU ever created. Powered by the new NVIDIA ® Pascal™ architecture, this breakthrough GPU delivers industry-leading performance, innovative new gaming technologies, and immersive next-gen VR.

PERFORMANCE

The ZOTAC GeForce ® GTX 10 Series comes with ultra-fast FinFET and high-bandwidth technologies, as well as support for DirectX 12 features to deliver the fastest, smoothest, most power-efficient gaming experiences.

THE LATEST GAMING TECHNOLOGIES

ZOTAC GeForce ® GTX 10 Series is built to meet the demands of next-generation displays, including VR, ultra-high-resolution, and multiple monitors. It features NVIDIA GameWorks™ technologies for extremely smooth gameplay and cinematic experiences, plus revolutionary new 360-degree image captureâeven in VR.

VR READY

Discover next-generation VR performance, the lowest latency, and plug-and-play compatibility with leading headsetsâdriven by NVIDIA VRWorks™ technologies. VR audio, physics, and haptics let you hear and feel every moment.

ZOTAC GeForce ® GTX 1080 Ti Series

PURE PERFORMANCE

The ultimate ZOTAC GeForce ® GTX pushes the limit hard and sets the bar for power, speed, stability, cooling, noise, durability, and gaming. Engineered for pure performance, it tugs at the enthusiast heart in all of us and leaves nothing to desire.

EXTREME SPEED

Finely tuned to perfection to extract every last bit of performance from the card before handing you the reigns. The GPU is significantly tuned to achieve supercar-like performance and thoroughly tested for system stability in the harshest of environments. Your system will be transformed into the ultimate predator with AMP Extreme at the helm.

COOLING IS KING

Each iteration of AMP brings more efficient cooling while maintaining the silence that gamers love. IceStorm cooling comes full force featuring enhancements fit for a king, so performance comes with style. This masterful combination of engineering prowess and fashionable style epitomizes AMP spirit.

ICESTORM

Cooler, tougher and brighter. IceStorm continues to revolutionize cooling with brute force. Each IceStorm utilizes direct copper contact to draw heat directly away from the core, and thermal heat pads on all heat generating components to maximize cooling efficiency. The fusion of cooling technologies offers outstanding cooling performance that enables gamers to push ever forward.

RADIATE BRILLIANCE

SPECTRA now shine ever brighter with attractive new features. New lighting modes and a much wider color spectrum are now at your command to personalize your ultimate gaming system. With three* lighting zones that shows off your unique brilliance, your unique customization begins with FireStorm.

*Available on ZOTAC GeForce GTX 1080 Ti AMP Extreme

THE SUPER ENGINE FOR ALL GAMERS

Each AMPed card comes in the stylish gunmetal gray to blend in any color scheme. You can feel quality and durability with every touch, and it is finished with front armor detailing that underlines its aggressiveness. This is the inch-perfect super engine for your gaming system.

POWER BOOST

POWERBOOST is a control chip that provides live electrical current regulation and instant electrical deviation responses. It reduces ripple noise and minimizes power fluctuation, resulting in a longer lasting AMPed graphics cards even in the most demanding situations. Even when pushed to the limit, it maintains smoothness and stability.

16 + 2 POWER PHASES

More power phases mean more turbines to generate the immense performance. Spreading the load to 16 power phases instead of the usual 10 means the horsepower is distributed evenly, meaning the card is a super car that purrs when operating at peak efficiency. All you will hear is unparalleled power radiating from the core.

ZOTAC GeForce ® GTX 1080 ArcticStorm

FEARLESS COOLING

Game hard and play fast without the heat. Get the best of both worlds with full throttle performance of NVIDIA Pascal™ combined with the fearless cooling of ArcticStorm. Bring your own liquid cooling hardware and light it up with Spectra to make it your card.

MORE CHANNEL, MORE FLOW

ArcticStorm is fitted with a direct copper cold plate contact engraved with precision micro-channels.

METAL WRAPAROUND BACKPLATE

ArcticStorm is equipped with a wraparound backplate to complete the appeal and look.

G 1/4 STANDARD FITTING

Using the standardized and most used fitting, ArcticStorm has a wide selection of liquid cooling hardware compatibility.

LIGHT IT WITH SPECTRA

Make it your own with just a few clicks on the all-new redesigned FireStorm utility.

ZOTAC GeForce ® GTX 1080 & 1070

FLY ABOVE THE LIMITS

Go extreme with the new ZOTAC GEFORCE ® GTX 1080 & 1070 series graphics card. Powered by the most advanced NVIDIA Pascal™ architecture and fine-tuned for maximum throttle, the new ZOTAC AMP Extreme will take you to the edge of performance

ICESTORM

Cooler, tougher and brighter. IceStorm continues to revolutionize cooling with brute force. Each IceStorm utilizes direct copper contact to draw heat directly away from the core, and thermal heat pads on all heat generating components to maximize cooling efficiency. The fusion of cooling technologies offers outstanding cooling performance that enables gamers to push ever forward.

Carbon ExoArmor

Carbon ExoArmor adds a functional aesthetic to the IceStorm cooling system to provide protection and durability. The redesigned wraparound backplate and metal fan shroud with carbon detailing complete the appeal with the look and feel of one.

SPECTRA

Spectra is an all new advanced lighting system that makes the card shine. Lighting in colors of your choice, utilize the redesigned FireStorm application to easily customize and set up your own color and lighting to suit your style. Whether it is a breathing fire red or a solid icy cold blue, make it "your card" with Spectra.

ZOTAC GEFORCE GTX 1080/1070 MINI

Ultra-performance now fits in 99% of systems. No need to ask "will it fit?"

ZOTAC GeForce ® GTX 1060

SUPER COMPACT

Small powerhouse designs to fit in 99% of systems. No need to ask "Will it fit?" Game Ready and VR Ready, they pack performance beyond their size so you can build the perfect compact system and play right along with the big boys.

SUPER COMPACT SOLUTIONS

Small powerhouse designs to fit 99% of systems. No need to ask "Will it fit?"

ICESTORM

Wide blades channel airflow for maximum movement. Superior heat transfer capabilities of copper heat-pipes and large aluminum fin array all combine to keep things cool and the gaming hot.

Available on ZOTAC GeForce GTX 1060 AMP Edition

ZOTAC GeForce ® GTX 1050 / 1050 Ti

THE 1080P GAMING CARD

The no hassle, no need to ask "will it fit?" just drop it in, load drivers, and get going graphics card. Needing only a minimum 300W power supply and up to 6.85 inch in length, these cards will instantly make almost any PC, powerful game ready systems capable of playing today's AAA game titles without breaking a sweat.

ULTRA COMPACT SOLUTIONS

Small powerhouse designs to fit in 99% of systems. No need to ask "Will it fit?" ZOTAC GeForce GTX 1050 Low Profile supports half heights slot.

PCIE BUS POWERED

No additional power supply connection needed means less wires and less clutter. Drop it in and secure it down for a simple and clean install.
